summary: Round 1: isolation is only checked in the UI, so a leaking API passes; reload persistence of filter+page has no observable criterion.

findings.problem: REQ-1 scenario only states 'the list shows A's operations'. Counterexample (API returns all rows, UI filters) passes. Constraint 'Do not expose data of other users' is not enforced by any criterion.
findings.expected_fix: Add a scenario asserting the API response for user A excludes user B's rows, with B having operations.

findings.problem: Request says filter and pagination work together 'also after reload'; AC-3 checks pagination without a filter and never reloads.
findings.expected_fix: AC-3: with filter applied, open page 2, reload, assert same items and filter state from URL.

checked_criteria: Intents re-derived independently and compared with intent-map.yaml
Each AC checked for observable result

payload.counterexample: GET /api/history returns every user's operations and the view hides foreign rows; current AC-1 (UI-only) accepts it.
